home.title: I'm Sanjana Diddige
home.description: I’m a passionate student with a strong focus on Law, Government, and Public Service. With a deep commitment to making a positive impact, I strive to contribute meaningfully to my community and beyond.

about.title: About Sanjana
content: Through my journey, I aim to blend my academic pursuits with hands-on experiences to shape a brighter, more equitable future.
My passion spans public speaking, leadership, community engagement, law and government.
I am a Rising High Schooler, Junior Optimist International Lt. Governor, Intern at Forsyth County Probate Court, and emerging leader at Kruti Dance Academy.
highlights: National Winner, DAR American History Essay Contest
Tech + Policy to improve local government services

eventDetails.title: My Arangetram
eventDetails.description: An Arangetram is not just the beginning of a solo journey in dance, but a devotion to the art form. This margam is an expression of poetry of the body, song of the soul, and spirit.

segments.title: First Segment
segments.content: The message of Brahmamokkate—that whether king or pauper, man or woman, sage or sinner, all are equal before God, aligns perfectly with what I wish to express... honoring divine equality in everyone.

segments.title: Second Segment
segments.content: Shifts into deeper abhinaya, where storytelling and emotion take center stage. With the Mahabharat Shabdam, I step into the vast world of epic narrative, embodying character and moral dilemmas. The Varnam, the longest and most demanding piece, becomes the emotional heart of my margam.

segments.title: Third Segment
segments.content: The most personal expression. A self-choreographed piece dedicated to Lord Shiva... followed by the Tillana which bursts forth with joy and rhythm, and finally the Mangalam to offer gratitude to my guru, the divine, and the audience.

segments.title: Special Dedication
segments.content: I also hope to present Aigiri Nandini as a Durga Keertanam. This hymn to Goddess Durga is special to me because it is tied so deeply to my mother’s childhood... sharing the stage with my mom will be an unforgettable moment.

law.title: DAR American History Essay Contest
law.description: Awarded the national prize by the Daughters of the American Revolution for an essay exploring pivotal moments in American history — competing against thousands of students across the country.
law.detail: This award recognized not just writing ability but a deep command of historical research and civic reasoning. The essay examined the intersection of revolutionary ideals and modern democratic principles, earning top marks at local, state, and national levels.

law.title: NCSS 1787 Prize
law.description: National Council for the Social Studies awarded Sanjana the 1787 Prize, recognizing outstanding scholarship in social studies and civic education at the national level.
law.detail: The NCSS 1787 Prize is one of the most prestigious recognitions in social studies education for young scholars. Sanjana's work demonstrated an exceptional understanding of constitutional history, federalism, and its relevance to contemporary governance.

law.title: Forsyth County Schools — Global Recognition
law.description: Featured in Forsyth County Schools news for earning global recognition in writing — a testament to academic excellence and civic voice that reached far beyond the classroom.
law.detail: The Forsyth County Schools feature highlighted Sanjana's achievement as a student whose writing earned recognition at both national and international levels, bringing pride to her school community and inspiring her peers.

leadership.title: Junior Optimist International — Lt. Governor
leadership.description: Elected as Lt. Governor for Junior Optimist International, leading district-level initiatives focused on youth empowerment, community service, and civic engagement.
leadership.detail: As Lt. Governor, Sanjana coordinates with club chapters across the district, organizes events, and mentors younger members. This role demands strategic leadership, public communication, and the ability to mobilize youth around shared civic goals.

leadership.title: Student of the Month — Optimist Club
leadership.description: Recognized as Student of the Month by the Optimist Club for outstanding contributions to civic life, academic achievement, and community involvement.
leadership.detail: This award reflects Sanjana's consistent dedication to excellence both inside and outside the classroom. The Optimist Club selects students who demonstrate exceptional character, leadership, and commitment to their community.

leadership.title: Youth Leadership Forsyth — Class of 2025
leadership.description: Completed the prestigious Youth Leadership Forsyth program (Class of 2025), a selective leadership development experience for emerging leaders in Forsyth County.
leadership.detail: Youth Leadership Forsyth is a highly competitive program that selects students with exceptional potential for community impact. Sanjana's completion of this program underscores her commitment to servant leadership and civic responsibility.

civicTech.title: John Locke Institute — Global Essay Prize
civicTech.description: Recognized at the prestigious John Locke Institute Global Essay Prize — one of the world's most competitive international essay competitions for students, drawing entries from over 80 countries.
civicTech.detail: The John Locke Institute Global Essay Prize challenges students to tackle complex philosophical, political, and economic questions at the highest academic level. Sanjana's recognition at this global stage reflects her exceptional depth of thinking, her command of argument, and her ability to engage with ideas that matter far beyond the classroom.

civicTech.title: DAR Award Ceremony & Recognition
civicTech.description: Honored at a formal DAR award ceremony alongside distinguished officials, celebrating her national essay contest victory and commitment to preserving American history.
civicTech.detail: The DAR ceremony brought together community leaders, educators, and distinguished guests to celebrate student achievement in American history. Sanjana's presence at this event marked a proud milestone in her journey as a civic scholar.

civicTech.title: JFK Profile in Courage Essay Contest
civicTech.description: Selected as a participant in the prestigious JFK Profile in Courage Essay Contest — a national competition honoring students who write compellingly about political courage.
civicTech.detail: The JFK Profile in Courage Essay Contest is one of the most respected academic competitions in the country. Sanjana's participation reflects her ability to engage meaningfully with questions of moral leadership, democratic values, and the responsibilities of public service.
